# Generate e2e — double-generation (REQ-010): two successive generates to the
# same abs dest (remove between) yield identical plan_sha256.
# Tree digests: integration/generate TestMatrixDoubleGeneration.

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/dbl
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/dbl

cp fixtures/nogit-cli.toml nogit.toml

# --- run A: plan then generate (observation=absent) ---
exec foundry plan --spec nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
cp stdout plan_a.json
dump_digest plan_a.json

exec foundry generate --spec nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
cp stdout gen_a.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_a.json gen_a.json
exists $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli/go.mod

# Remove destination for second clean generate.
rm -rf $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli

# --- run B: same abs path → same plan_sha256 ---
exec foundry plan --spec nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli --output json
cp stdout plan_b.json

exec foundry generate --spec nogit.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/dbl/nogit-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
cp stdout gen_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_b.json gen_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_a.json plan_b.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq gen_a.json gen_b.json
